items.text: It should turn that direction into a concrete job-search action plan, then keep checking whether outreach, applications, and interview follow-through are actually happening, so the high-value skill portfolio you build through the search keeps compounding toward the decisions that unlock high income opportunities and earlier financial freedom instead of the search quietly stalling out.

Coaching is delivered fully online across India, so the accountability loop works from home, a hostel, or your first workplace, around whatever stage of the search or the first job you are already in.
